paragraphs.text: Construct is a catch-all creature type used for artificial life forms powered by mechanical means. All Constructs are artifact creatures , except Slag Fiend .

Constructs are different from Golems , which are created through magic, but there is some degree of ambiguity between these types in the game. They can be thought of as robots or automatons and come in a wide variety of forms, often imitating organic life. Design treats the Construct subtype as a catch-all group for artifact creatures in the same manner as they treat Beast . Robots are considered to be a specific sub-group of Constructs, but not every Construct is a Robot.

The first creature to bear the construct type was Bronze Bombshell in Dissension , though many cards from Antiquities were later issued errata in the Grand Creature Type Update to become constructs as well.
Esperite artificers are known to build specialized constructs out of Etherium .
Constructs are among the many artifact creatures employed at the Biblioplex . More specialized constructs have been built to assist the Archaeomancers of Lorehold .
Mechanical butlers are considered a luxury item and status symbol among social climbers in the Mezzio section of New Capenna .

Constructs have a long history on Dominaria , and every major organization of Artificers on the plane has its take on them. In the modern day, they are most common around New Argive and on the various Tolarian campuses.
Historically, they were employed by the ancient Thran , and later by both sides of the Brothers' War . Powerstones are among the most common power sources for Dominarian constructs.
Among the Courts of the Realm , Constructs are most common among the mages of Vantress . Further, into the Wilds, other artisans have developed stranger artifact creatures.
The Academy at Palliano constantly churned out new clockwork constructs, although the rate has slowed since the exile of Muzzio from the city.

Constructs are occasionally built by Necro-Alchemists on Innistrad . These constructs are usually powered by trapped geists . The plane's malevolent animate toys (such as Creepy Doll ) are also classified as constructs.

Constructs of all shapes and sizes (often identified as Automata ), powered by clockworks and Aether cells, are common all across Kaladesh . Some are built to serve a specific purpose in the civic maintenance of Ghirapur , while others are built for prizefighting or purely out of experimental curiosity.

The recent technological renaissance on Kamigawa has led to an explosion of new constructs (often called Bots ) emerging from the labs and workshops of the Saiba Futurists and the Asari Uprisers . Most Kamigawan bots are powered by the Futurists' controlled Merge Gate technology and are vital to the functioning of Towashi .
Constructs were ubiquitous on Mirrodin , with many arising "naturally" from the plane's mechanized ecosystems, or were deliberately placed there in Memnarch 's reshaping of the plane.
Many others were built or modified by Mirrodin's humanoid civilizations, all of whom developed an affinity for artifice in response to their environment.

Upon the plane's transformation into New Phyrexia, the non-sapient constructs largely lacked the willpower and direction to avoid compleation , becoming just as vital a part of the Progress Engine and Quiet Furnace as they had been for Lumengrid and Kuldotha before them.
Little is known about the wandering construct Sundial other than it follows the dawn sun. It is revered by the Dawnchaser Pilgrims .
A wide variety of Hedron -based constructs can be found on Zendikar , likely the product of kor lithomancy.
